transformation.method: For each selected LevelUp ID, locate exactly one ConfigDataCastingLawLevelUpInfo record by numeric ID equality; preserve each of the 12 Property keys independently. Missing keys have state ABSENT and no rawValue property. Present values retain original JSON type and value. No pairing, fill, conversion, or semantic join is applied.

limitation: Source-native Property1_ID through Property6_ID and Property1_Value through Property6_Value observations only. No Property definition, stat name, unit, scale, combat effect, formula, runtime application, progression, cost/material consumption, localization, asset, or publication meaning is admitted.
